title: Real-time chemical characterization of primary and aged biomass burning aerosols derived from sub-Saharan African biomass fuels in smoldering fires
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2024, 4,1382-1397
DOI: 10.1039/D4EA00110A, Paper

Markie’Sha James, Vaios Moschos, Megan M. McRee, Marc N. Fiddler, Barbara J. Turpin, Jason D. Surratt, Solomon Bililign
The influence of biomass burning (BB)-derived organic aerosol (OA) emissions on solar radiation via absorption and scattering is related to their physicochemical properties and can change upon atmospheric aging.
